title: fix(metadata,runtime): a multi-package config boot registers its unowned top level under manifest.id, as the artifact boot does
body:
Fixes #22521
Clause-②: no
The config boot gains the answer the artifact boot of the same project already gives: a top-level item no package owns is registered under `manifest.id`, with the metadata plugin's warning. No key, export or error code is removed. One corner now refuses at boot what booted before: a residual view container whose own `name` is not its object. That corner narrows the accepted set. `os validate` and `os build` refuse it first, in the same words. The `domain:cli` seat puts the narrowing to the director seat, and that seat chooses the `Clause-②` arm.

## What this does

A config boot (`os serve objectstack.config.ts`, with or without `--dev`) of a stack that carries `packages[]` hands the stack to the `manifest` service. That service registers the package bodies and never the top level. A top-level item that no package body declares was served by no door, and the boot said nothing. `os build` of the same project, booted as an artifact, registered the same items under `manifest.id`, and the metadata plugin warned.

Both doors now run one residual rule, `MetadataPlugin.registerUnclaimedTopLevel` (`packages/metadata/src/plugin.ts`). Which top-level items are residual, and their owner, is the rule's pure half: `unclaimedTopLevel(stack)`, exported from `@objectstack/metadata`.

- **The artifact door** calls the rule from `_parseAndRegisterArtifact`, unchanged in behaviour. It makes the same registrations and prints the same lines, byte for byte, refusals included.
- **The config door** is `AppPlugin.start()` (`packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts`). It calls the rule with the metadata service's in-memory registry as its sink, and skips when the composition declares the artifact door (`securityMetadataRegistrar: 'artifact-door'`). That keeps one registrar per boot.
- **The author-time door.** `os validate` and `os build` judge view containers through `findViewContainerNameRefusals` (`packages/cli/src/utils/view-container-names.ts`). That walk now also judges the residual containers of a multi-package stack, reading `unclaimedTopLevel`. The CLI never re-derives which items are residual.

⛔ No residual rule is written in `app-plugin.ts`, `serve.ts` or the CLI walk.

## What changes

- **Served.** A config boot lists every top-level item no package body declares under the stack's `manifest.id`, and prints one `warn` line with the count: `config stack 'ID' carries N top-level metadata item(s) that none of its M package bodies declare`, followed by the remedy (declare each item inside the `packages[]` entry that owns it).
- **A new refusal, in one corner.** A residual view container is judged like any other container. A top-level `defineView` container that no package declares, and whose own `name` is not the object it binds to, now refuses the config boot. The refusal reads `Invalid` + `views:` + `container from manifest 'MANIFEST_ID': the container's own name is ...`. On `main` that config booted, because its top level was never read; an artifact boot of the same project already refused it, as `from artifact`. `os validate` and `os build` now refuse the same container first, in the same words. A divergent container that a package body declares and the top level repeats is refused once, as that package's. **The one-line fix:** drop the container's `name`, or set it to the object it binds to.
- **The words on the config door.** The residual container refusal names its source `manifest`, the word the config boot's own registrar and `os validate` already use for the same stack. The artifact door keeps `artifact`.
- **The changeset** carries one sentence superseding, in the same release, the pending `.changeset/22405-serve-flat-docs-owner.md` note "A config boot of such a stack still does not list them". That file is not edited, per the foreign-changeset rule.

## Before and after, round 1 (row × door × listed / warned)

Readings were taken through the public doors on real boots, with the authenticated `GET /api/v1/meta/{doc,object,view}` and the boot output. "Before" is base `86f53a4b8d`. "After" is this branch.

| row | fixture | door | before: listed | before: warned | after: listed | after: warned |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | composed, `manifest.id` names the app package, flat `src/docs` | config `--dev` / artifact | under the app package (PR #22520) | no / no | unchanged | no / no |
| 2 | `manifest.id` names no package, flat `src/docs` | config | not listed | no | listed under `manifest.id` | yes, count 2 |
| 2 | same | config `--dev` | not listed | no | listed under `manifest.id` | yes, count 2 |
| 2 | same | artifact | listed under `manifest.id` | yes, count 2 | unchanged | unchanged |
| 3 | inline `docs` spread on a composed stack's top level | config / config `--dev` | not listed | no | listed under `manifest.id` (the app's, composed last) | yes, count 1 |
| 3 | same | artifact | NOT MEASURED: `os build` refuses the shape with "the default export was not built by `defineStack`", so no artifact exists | n/a | same refusal | n/a |
| 4 | row 2 plus a top-level object and a top-level view container | config / config `--dev` | object, view and docs not listed (by-name 404) | no | object, expanded view and docs listed under `manifest.id` | yes, count 5 |
| 4 | same | artifact | object, expanded view and docs listed under `manifest.id` | yes, count 5 | unchanged | unchanged |
| control | one package, no `packages[]` | config / config `--dev` / artifact | everything under its one package | no | unchanged | no |

In row 4 the config door also gives the artifact door's answer on the two doors this PR does not pin. The data door answers 404 for the residual object on both doors. The by-name view read answers 500 on both doors, and it answers 500 on an artifact boot of the single-package control too. The seat files both as findings.

## Before and after, round 2: a divergent view container no package owns

The fixture is the neutral two-package config, with `manifest.id` naming no package and one top-level container `{ name: 'account_list', object: 'acme_account', list: ... }`. The "claimed" variant also declares that container on the app body.

| fixture | door | base `86f53a4b8d` | round 1 head `3c69fda05` | this head `c1db768097` |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| residual | `os validate` | exit 0 | exit 0 | exit 1, refused `from manifest 'com.example.acme.release'` (1 view container) |
| residual | `os serve` config `--dev` | booted | refused `from artifact 'com.example.acme.release'` | refused `from manifest 'com.example.acme.release'` |
| residual | `os build` | exit 0, artifact written | exit 0, artifact written | exit 1, no artifact, same words |
| claimed | `os validate` / `os build` | exit 1, refused once `from manifest 'com.example.acme'` | same | same |
| claimed | `os serve` config `--dev` | refused once, the body's | same | same |

## Mechanism hypotheses, measured

- **H1 holds.** `AppPlugin.init()` hands `{ ...manifest, ...bundle }` to `getService('manifest').register()`. `ObjectQLPlugin`'s manifest service runs `resolveArtifactPackageOrder(artifact)`, which answers the bodies alone when `packages` is present, and calls `registerApp` per body. The boot shows this too. Before this change, a multi-package config whose top level carried a malformed view container booted clean. The single-package config with the same view refused at boot. The top level never reached registration, for docs, objects and views alike.
- **H2 holds.** The artifact door registers each body, then registers what no body claimed under `manifest.id`, and warns. The warning counts were 2 for row 2 and 5 for row 4: 2 docs, 1 object, 1 view container and 1 expanded view.
- **H3 holds.** On a config boot, `createStandaloneStack` composes `MetadataPlugin` over `dist/objectstack.json`. That file is absent, so the door loads nothing and the config never reaches it. The listing (`readFlattenedMetaItems`) merges the engine registry with `metadataService.list()`. On the artifact boot the residual object is listed on `/meta/object` while the data door answers 404, so the residual lives only in the metadata service.
- **H4 holds, and it decides the fold.** `placeCollectedDocs` is placement, the one `os build` uses (`compile.ts` calls it too). It is not a residual rule, and it also attaches each package's own `src/PACKAGE/docs/` set.

## The fold decision: `serve.ts`'s `placeCollectedDocs` call stays

To measure it, the flat placement was withheld (`flatDocs: []`, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, then restored by blob) and row 1 was booted with the fix in place. The flat pages were still served under the app package, but as a residual. The config boot printed "2 top-level metadata item(s)", and the artifact boot of the same project printed nothing. Removing the call would therefore make the two doors disagree, and removing it whole would also drop the per-package docs. Only its comment changes, to say it is placement. Row 1's pin stays green.

## Files

- `packages/metadata/src/plugin.ts`:
  - `unclaimedTopLevel(stack)` is the pure residual decision: the unclaimed items with their field, index and type, the owner id and version, and the body count. `registerUnclaimedTopLevel` registers exactly those items.
  - The body-registration loop is a module-level function that writes through a sink. The artifact door's sink is its in-memory loader followed by the manager, the same two writes in the same order. The loop takes the refusal's source word: `artifact` on the artifact door, `manifest` for the config door's residual.
  - A body's claimed slots are read by the slot derivation the registration uses. The artifact door's pins are unedited and green.
- `packages/metadata/src/index.ts`: exports `unclaimedTopLevel` and its two types.
- `packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts`: the config door calls the rule from `start()`, ahead of the ADR-0057 security block, and skips on an artifact-door composition. `@objectstack/runtime` already depends on `@objectstack/metadata`.
- `packages/cli/src/utils/view-container-names.ts` and its test: the walk judges the residual containers after the bodies, at their top-level path, under the residual's owner id. The module header now states that walk.
- `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts`: a comment only (the fold decision).
- `packages/cli/test/serve-config-boot-residual.integration.test.ts`: the pin, with one fixture per row (2, 3, 4) and a single-package control. The row 4 refusal corner pins that `os serve`, `os validate` and `os build` refuse the residual container with the judge's message, and that a claimed one is refused once, as the body's.
- `packages/runtime/src/standalone-stack-security-catalog-one-holder.test.ts`: one stale comment line.
- `.changeset/22521-config-boot-residual.md`: `patch` for `@objectstack/runtime`, `@objectstack/metadata` and `@objectstack/cli`.

**The warning.** The sentence and the count are the artifact door's. Only the noun and the remedy follow the door: an artifact is told to be rebuilt, a config is told to declare each item in the `packages[]` entry that owns it.

## Verification (this head, c1db768097)

- **The pins.** `vitest run --project integration` over `serve-config-boot-residual`, `serve-config-boot-flat-docs`, `serve-package-declared-capabilities` and `schema-migrate.requires-providers.integration`: `Test Files 4 passed (4)`, `Tests 25 passed (25)`.
- **The walk.** `view-container-names.test`, `build-view-container-name.test`, `validate-build-gate-parity.test` and `validate-view-container-name.test`: `Test Files 4 passed (4)`, `Tests 44 passed (44)`.
- **Round 2 ablation, the walk.** Committed first, then `view-container-names.ts` was restored to `3c69fda05` (blob `a61633a25b`; `unclaimedTopLevel` 0 hits in the file).
  - Unit: `Tests 1 failed | 6 passed (7)`. The red case is the unclaimed-container case.
  - The pin's refusal corner: `Tests 2 failed | 2 passed`. The red cases are `os validate` and `os build`, which printed "Validation passed" and "Build complete". `os serve` and the claimed case stayed green.
  - Restored to the HEAD blob `3c0f4cdf0a`, with 0 dirty paths.
- **Round 1 ablations (at `12de4b4656`).**
  - The config door's call, removed through a dist-proven rebuild: `Tests 4 failed | 5 passed (9)`, the four config-boot parity cases.
  - The artifact-door skip, disabled: the artifact boot printed `[ 2, 2 ]`, `Tests 3 failed | 6 skipped (9)`.
  - Both were restored by blob.
- **Metadata.** Typecheck green. `Test Files 58 passed (58)`, `Tests 871 passed (871)`. The artifact-door files plus `view-container-name.test`, run verbose: `Test Files 10 passed (10)`, `Tests 101 passed (101)`.
- **Runtime.** Typecheck green. `vitest run --project local`: `Test Files 345 passed (345)`, `Tests 4909 passed | 19 skipped`.
- **CLI.** Typecheck green, and the CLI was built. The unit layer: `Test Files 277 passed (277)`, `Tests 4107 passed (4107)`.
- **Dogfood.** `multi-package-artifact` and `picklist-shared-across-objects`: `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 14 passed (14)`.
- **Gates.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (no paths) derives 70 families at this head, all exit 0. `check:i18n-coverage` first exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: `@objectstack/connector-slack` was unbuilt in this worktree), and gave "OK (13 config(s), 621 baselined untranslated string(s), none new)" after `pnpm --filter @objectstack/connector-slack build`. `check:type-check-debt` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` ran last. `--ran`: "70 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 70 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero ...)".
- **Lint (a proven narrowing).**
  1. The population comes from `eslint.config.mjs`, whose `files` glob is every `ts`, `tsx`, `mts`, `cts`, `js`, `jsx`, `mjs` and `cjs` file.
  2. `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` on the 9 changed paths returned 9 results: 8 source and test files with 0 errors and 0 warnings, and the changeset `.md` reported as "File ignored because no matching configuration was supplied".
  3. The config has no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`, and at load it reads only `scripts/slot-lookup-baseline.json` and `scripts/query-options-erasure-baseline.json`, both untouched. So the diff cannot move the verdict on any file it does not touch.

  The full `pnpm lint` is CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- **Filed by the seat.** On an artifact boot, `GET /api/v1/meta/view/acme_note` answers 500. Separately, a residual object is listed by the metadata door while the data door answers 404.
- **No forward conversion on the config door's residual.** The config door registers residual items as the config carries them, which is how this door registers its package bodies. Security collections keep the ADR-0057 block's forward-converted copy, because that block runs after the residual.
- **The CLI walk now imports the `@objectstack/metadata` root.** It needs `unclaimedTopLevel`. Measured after `@objectstack/objectql`, which `os validate` already loads, the import costs about 19 ms on a shared box.
